WITH users_7day AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201231' AND '20210107'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS ep
      WHERE ep.key = 'engagement_time_msec' AND ep.value.int_value > 0
    )
),
users_2day AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20210106' AND '20210107'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS ep
      WHERE ep.key = 'engagement_time_msec' AND ep.value.int_value > 0
    )
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_distinct_pseudo_users
FROM users_7day u7
WHERE u7.user_pseudo_id NOT IN (SELECT user_pseudo_id FROM users_2day)

WITH youtube_buyers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fullVisitorId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_201707*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS h,
  UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE p.v2ProductCategory = 'Home/Shop by Brand/YouTube/'
    AND p.productQuantity IS NOT NULL
    AND p.productQuantity > 0
),
visitor_products AS (
  SELECT 
    s.fullVisitorId,
    p.v2ProductName,
    p.productQuantity
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_201707*` AS s,
  UNNEST(hits) AS h,
  UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE p.v2ProductName IS NOT NULL
    AND p.productQuantity IS NOT NULL
    AND p.productQuantity > 0
    AND LOWER(p.v2ProductName) NOT LIKE '%youtube%'
    AND LOWER(p.v2ProductName) NOT LIKE '%you tube%'
)
SELECT 
  vp.v2ProductName,
  SUM(vp.productQuantity) AS total_quantity
FROM visitor_products vp
INNER JOIN youtube_buyers yb ON yb.fullVisitorId = vp.fullVisitorId
GROUP BY vp.v2ProductName
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH sessions AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    date,
    device.isMobile as is_mobile,
    visitStartTime,
    totals.transactions
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
),
user_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    MIN(date) as first_visit_date,
    MAX(date) as last_visit_date,
    MIN(CASE WHEN transactions > 0 THEN date END) as first_transaction_date
  FROM sessions
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId
)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_stats

SELECT 
  CAST(table_year AS INT64) AS year,
  AVG(average_medicare_payments * total_discharges) AS avg_inpatient_cost,
  AVG(average_total_payments * outpatient_services) AS avg_outpatient_cost
FROM (
  SELECT provider_id, provider_name, average_medicare_payments, total_discharges, CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64) AS average_total_payments, CAST(NULL AS INT64) AS outpatient_services, '2011' AS table_year FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_2011`
  UNION ALL
  SELECT provider_id, provider_name, average_medicare_payments, total_discharges, CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64), CAST(NULL AS INT64), '2012' FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_2012`
  UNION ALL
  SELECT provider_id, provider_name, average_medicare_payments, total_discharges, CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64), CAST(NULL AS INT64), '2013' FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_2013`
  UNION ALL
  SELECT provider_id, provider_name, average_medicare_payments, total_discharges, CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64), CAST(NULL AS INT64), '2014' FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_2014`
  UNION ALL
  SELECT provider_id, provider_name, average_medicare_payments, total_discharges, CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64), CAST(NULL AS INT64), '2015' FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_2015`
  UNION ALL
  SELECT provider_id, provider_name, CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64), CAST(NULL AS INT64), average_total_payments, outpatient_services, '2011' FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.outpatient_charges_2011`
  UNION ALL
  SELECT provider_id, provider_name, CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64), CAST(NULL AS INT64), average_total_payments, outpatient_services, '2012' FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.outpatient_charges_2012`
  UNION ALL
  SELECT provider_id, provider_name, CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64), CAST(NULL AS INT64), average_total_payments, outpatient_services, '2013' FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.outpatient_charges_2013`
  UNION ALL
  SELECT provider_id, provider_name, CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64), CAST(NULL AS INT64), average_total_payments, outpatient_services, '2014' FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.outpatient_charges_2014`
  UNION ALL
  SELECT provider_id, provider_name, CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64), CAST(NULL AS INT64), average_total_payments, outpatient_services, '2015' FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.outpatient_charges_2015`
)
WHERE provider_id = '330101'
GROUP BY table_year
ORDER BY year

WITH quinapril_ingredient_id AS (
  SELECT concept_id as ingredient_concept_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept`
  WHERE concept_code = '35208'
),
quinapril_drugs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ds.drug_concept_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.drug_strength` ds,
       quinapril_ingredient_id qi
  WHERE ds.ingredient_concept_id = qi.ingredient_concept_id
),
persons_with_quinapril AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT de.person_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.drug_exposure` de
  JOIN quinapril_drugs qd ON de.drug_concept_id = qd.drug_concept_id
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.person`) - 
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM persons_with_quinapril),
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.person`)
    ) * 100, 2
  ) as percentage_not_using_quinapril

WITH storm_points AS (
  SELECT 
    sid,
    name,
    usa_latitude,
    usa_longitude,
    iso_time,
    LEAD(usa_latitude) OVER (PARTITION BY sid ORDER BY iso_time) AS next_lat,
    LEAD(usa_longitude) OVER (PARTITION BY sid ORDER BY iso_time) AS next_lon
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes`
  WHERE season = '2020' AND basin = 'NA'
),
distances AS (
  SELECT 
    sid,
    name,
    SUM(ST_DISTANCE(
      ST_GEOGPOINT(usa_longitude, usa_latitude),
      ST_GEOGPOINT(next_lon, next_lat)
    )) AS total_distance_meters
  FROM storm_points
  WHERE next_lat IS NOT NULL AND next_lon IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY sid, name
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT sid, name, total_distance_meters,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_distance_meters DESC) as rn
  FROM distances
)
SELECT r.sid, r.name, r.total_distance_meters / 1000 AS total_distance_km,
       h.usa_latitude AS final_latitude,
       h.usa_longitude AS final_longitude,
       h.iso_time AS last_time
FROM ranked r
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes` h
  ON r.sid = h.sid
WHERE r.rn = 2
  AND h.iso_time = (
    SELECT MAX(iso_time)
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes`
    WHERE season = '2020' AND basin = 'NA' AND sid = r.sid
  )

-- Final query: Hurricane Laura (3rd longest travel distance in 2020 NA)
-- Show travel coordinates, cumulative distance, and max sustained wind speed
WITH storm_points AS (
  SELECT 
    sid, name, season,
    iso_time,
    ST_GEOGPOINT(usa_longitude, usa_latitude) AS geo_point,
    usa_wind
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes` 
  WHERE basin = 'NA' AND season = '2020' AND sid = '2020233N14313'
),
storm_with_prev AS (
  SELECT 
    sid, name, season,
    iso_time,
    geo_point,
    usa_wind,
    LAG(geo_point) OVER (PARTITION BY sid ORDER BY iso_time) AS prev_point,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sid ORDER BY iso_time) AS rn
  FROM storm_points
),
distances AS (
  SELECT 
    sid, name, season,
    iso_time,
    geo_point,
    usa_wind,
    ST_DISTANCE(geo_point, prev_point) AS dist_meters,
    rn
  FROM storm_with_prev
  WHERE prev_point IS NOT NULL
),
cumulative AS (
  SELECT 
    sid, name, season,
    iso_time,
    geo_point,
    usa_wind,
    SUM(dist_meters) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) / 1000 AS cumulative_km
  FROM distances
)
SELECT 
  name,
  iso_time,
  ROUND(ST_X(geo_point), 4) AS longitude,
  ROUND(ST_Y(geo_point), 4) AS latitude,
  ROUND(cumulative_km, 2) AS cumulative_km,
  usa_wind
FROM cumulative
ORDER BY iso_time

WITH country_daily AS (
  SELECT 
    g.date,
    s.country,
    AVG(g.max) as avg_max,
    AVG(g.min) as avg_min,
    AVG(g.temp) as avg_temp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2023` g
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations` s 
    ON g.stn = s.usaf AND g.wban = s.wban
  WHERE g.mo = '10' AND g.da BETWEEN '01' AND '31'
    AND s.country IN ('US', 'UK')
    AND g.temp != 9999.9
    AND g.max != 9999.9
    AND g.min != 9999.9
  GROUP BY g.date, s.country
)
SELECT 
  date,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN country = 'US' THEN avg_max END) - AVG(CASE WHEN country = 'UK' THEN avg_max END), 1) as diff_max,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN country = 'US' THEN avg_min END) - AVG(CASE WHEN country = 'UK' THEN avg_min END), 1) as diff_min,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN country = 'US' THEN avg_temp END) - AVG(CASE WHEN country = 'UK' THEN avg_temp END), 1) as diff_temp
FROM country_daily
GROUP BY date
ORDER BY date

-- Final query: All stations within 20 miles with valid temp observation counts
SELECT 
  s.usaf,
  s.wban,
  s.name,
  ROUND(s.lat, 4) as latitude,
  ROUND(s.lon, 4) as longitude,
  ROUND(
    ST_DISTANCE(
      ST_GEOGPOINT(s.lon, s.lat),
      ST_GEOGPOINT(-73.764, 41.197)
    ) / 1609.344, 2
  ) as distance_miles,
  COALESCE(COUNT(w.temp), 0) as valid_temp_observations
FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations` s
LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*` w
  ON s.usaf = w.stn 
  AND s.wban = w.wban
  AND _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2020'
  AND w.temp IS NOT NULL
  AND w.temp != 9999.9
WHERE ST_DWITHIN(
    ST_GEOGPOINT(s.lon, s.lat),
    ST_GEOGPOINT(-73.764, 41.197),
    32186.88
  )
  AND s.lat != 0.0 AND s.lon != 0.0
GROUP BY s.usaf, s.wban, s.name, s.lat, s.lon
ORDER BY distance_miles

WITH 
-- Get daily average temperature from both stations (2008-2017)
daily_temp AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE) AS date,
    AVG(temp) as avg_temp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2008' AND '2017'
    AND stn IN ('725030', '744860')
    AND temp != 9999.9
    AND temp IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY date
),
-- Get daily complaint counts per type
daily_complaints AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(created_date AS DATE) AS date,
    complaint_type,
    COUNT(*) as complaint_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_date) BETWEEN 2008 AND 2017
  GROUP BY date, complaint_type
),
-- Get total daily complaints
daily_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(created_date AS DATE) AS date,
    COUNT(*) as total_daily_complaints
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_date) BETWEEN 2008 AND 2017
  GROUP BY date
),
-- Get complaint types with > 5000 total occurrences
qualifying_types AS (
  SELECT complaint_type
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_date) BETWEEN 2008 AND 2017
  GROUP BY complaint_type
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 5000
),
-- Join everything together
joined AS (
  SELECT 
    t.date,
    t.avg_temp,
    c.complaint_type,
    c.complaint_count,
    d.total_daily_complaints,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(c.complaint_count, d.total_daily_complaints) * 100 as pct_complaints
  FROM daily_temp t
  JOIN daily_totals d ON t.date = d.date
  JOIN daily_complaints c ON t.date = c.date
  JOIN qualifying_types q ON c.complaint_type = q.complaint_type
),
-- Compute all metrics per complaint type
metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    complaint_type,
    COUNT(*) as num_days,
    SUM(complaint_count) as total_complaints,
    -- Pearson correlation for complaint count vs temp
    (COUNT(*) * SUM(avg_temp * complaint_count) - SUM(avg_temp) * SUM(complaint_count)) 
    / NULLIF(SQRT(
      (COUNT(*) * SUM(avg_temp * avg_temp) - SUM(avg_temp) * SUM(avg_temp))
      * (COUNT(*) * SUM(complaint_count * complaint_count) - SUM(complaint_count) * SUM(complaint_count))
    ), 0) as corr_temp_count,
    -- Pearson correlation for percentage vs temp
    (COUNT(*) * SUM(avg_temp * pct_complaints) - SUM(avg_temp) * SUM(pct_complaints)) 
    / NULLIF(SQRT(
      (COUNT(*) * SUM(avg_temp * avg_temp) - SUM(avg_temp) * SUM(avg_temp))
      * (COUNT(*) * SUM(pct_complaints * pct_complaints) - SUM(pct_complaints) * SUM(pct_complaints))
    ), 0) as corr_temp_pct
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY complaint_type
)
SELECT 
  complaint_type,
  num_days,
  total_complaints,
  ROUND(corr_temp_count, 4) as corr_temp_count,
  ROUND(corr_temp_pct, 4) as corr_temp_pct
FROM metrics
WHERE ABS(corr_temp_count) > 0.5
ORDER BY complaint_type

WITH trees_1995 AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(spc_latin) AS latin_name,
    CASE WHEN SPLIT(spc_common, '-')[OFFSET(0)] IS NOT NULL THEN SPLIT(spc_common, '-')[OFFSET(0)] ELSE spc_common END AS common_name,
    status,
    CASE WHEN status IN ('Good', 'Excellent', 'Poor', 'Fair', 'Critical') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_alive,
    CASE WHEN status IN ('Dead', 'Stump') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_dead
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_1995`
  WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND spc_latin != ''
),
trees_2015 AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(spc_latin) AS latin_name,
    spc_common AS common_name,
    status,
    CASE WHEN status = 'Alive' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_alive,
    CASE WHEN status IN ('Dead', 'Stump') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_dead
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_2015`
  WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND spc_latin != ''
),
agg_1995 AS (
  SELECT latin_name,
    COUNT(*) AS total_count,
    SUM(is_alive) AS alive_count,
    SUM(is_dead) AS dead_count
  FROM trees_1995
  GROUP BY latin_name
),
agg_2015 AS (
  SELECT latin_name,
    COUNT(*) AS total_count,
    SUM(is_alive) AS alive_count,
    SUM(is_dead) AS dead_count
  FROM trees_2015
  GROUP BY latin_name
),
common_names AS (
  SELECT latin_name, 
    common_name,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY latin_name ORDER BY cnt DESC) as rn
  FROM (
    SELECT latin_name, common_name, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM trees_1995 GROUP BY latin_name, common_name
    UNION ALL
    SELECT latin_name, common_name, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM trees_2015 GROUP BY latin_name, common_name
  )
)
SELECT 
  a19.latin_name,
  cn.common_name,
  a19.total_count AS total_1995,
  a15.total_count AS total_2015,
  a19.alive_count AS alive_1995,
  a15.alive_count AS alive_2015,
  a19.dead_count AS dead_1995,
  a15.dead_count AS dead_2015,
  a15.total_count - a19.total_count AS total_growth,
  a15.alive_count - a19.alive_count AS alive_growth,
  a15.dead_count - a19.dead_count AS dead_growth
FROM agg_1995 a19
JOIN agg_2015 a15 ON a19.latin_name = a15.latin_name
JOIN common_names cn ON a19.latin_name = cn.latin_name AND cn.rn = 1
ORDER BY (a15.total_count - a19.total_count) DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH filtered_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    t.pickup_datetime,
    t.dropoff_datetime,
    t.passenger_count,
    t.trip_distance,
    t.fare_amount,
    t.mta_tax,
    t.tip_amount,
    t.tolls_amount,
    t.total_amount,
    t.pickup_location_id,
    dbo.borough AS pickup_borough
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.tlc_yellow_trips_2016` t
  LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` dbo
    ON t.pickup_location_id = dbo.zone_id
  WHERE t.pickup_datetime >= '2016-01-01'
    AND t.pickup_datetime < '2016-01-08'
    AND dbo.borough NOT IN ('EWR', 'Staten Island')
    AND t.dropoff_datetime > t.pickup_datetime
    AND t.passenger_count > 0
    AND t.trip_distance >= 0
    AND t.tip_amount >= 0
    AND t.tolls_amount >= 0
    AND t.mta_tax >= 0
    AND t.fare_amount >= 0
    AND t.total_amount >= 0
),
classified AS (
  SELECT 
    pickup_borough,
    CASE 
      WHEN tip_amount = 0 THEN 'no tip'
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, total_amount) * 100 <= 5 THEN 'Less than 5%'
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, total_amount) * 100 > 5 AND SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, total_amount) * 100 <= 10 THEN '5% to 10%'
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, total_amount) * 100 > 10 AND SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, total_amount) * 100 <= 15 THEN '10% to 15%'
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, total_amount) * 100 > 15 AND SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, total_amount) * 100 <= 20 THEN '15% to 20%'
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, total_amount) * 100 > 20 AND SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, total_amount) * 100 <= 25 THEN '20% to 25%'
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, total_amount) * 100 > 25 THEN 'More than 25%'
    END AS tip_category
  FROM filtered_trips
)
SELECT 
  pickup_borough,
  tip_category,
  COUNT(*) AS num_trips,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(*), SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY pickup_borough)) AS proportion
FROM classified
GROUP BY pickup_borough, tip_category
ORDER BY pickup_borough, 
  CASE tip_category
    WHEN 'no tip' THEN 1
    WHEN 'Less than 5%' THEN 2
    WHEN '5% to 10%' THEN 3
    WHEN '10% to 15%' THEN 4
    WHEN '15% to 20%' THEN 5
    WHEN '20% to 25%' THEN 6
    WHEN 'More than 25%' THEN 7
  END

WITH clay AS (
  SELECT trip_id, departure_time, stop_sequence
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_transit_muni.stop_times`
  WHERE stop_id = 14015
),
sacramento AS (
  SELECT trip_id, arrival_time, stop_sequence
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_transit_muni.stop_times`
  WHERE stop_id = 16294
),
valid_trips AS (
  SELECT c.trip_id
  FROM clay c
  JOIN sacramento s ON c.trip_id = s.trip_id
  WHERE c.stop_sequence < s.stop_sequence
)
SELECT 
  r.route_short_name,
  t.trip_headsign,
  MIN(c.departure_time) AS earliest_departure,
  MAX(s.arrival_time) AS latest_arrival
FROM valid_trips vt
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_transit_muni.trips` t ON CAST(vt.trip_id AS STRING) = t.trip_id
JOIN clay c ON vt.trip_id = c.trip_id
JOIN sacramento s ON vt.trip_id = s.trip_id
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_transit_muni.routes` r ON t.route_id = r.route_id
GROUP BY r.route_short_name, t.trip_headsign
ORDER BY r.route_short_name, t.trip_headsign

-- Let me check how many countries we have and see the full result
WITH covid_cases AS (
    SELECT 
        country_name,
        country_code,
        MAX(cumulative_confirmed) AS cumulative_confirmed
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_open_data.covid19_open_data`
    WHERE date <= '2020-06-30'
    GROUP BY country_name, country_code
),
code_mapping AS (
    SELECT 
        two_alpha_code,
        country_code AS three_letter_code
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_health_population.country_summary`
),
world_pop AS (
    SELECT 
        country,
        country_code AS three_letter_code,
        year_2018 AS population_2018
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_global_population.population_by_country`
    WHERE year_2018 IS NOT NULL AND year_2018 > 0
)
SELECT 
    c.country_name,
    c.country_code,
    c.cumulative_confirmed,
    w.population_2018,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(c.cumulative_confirmed * 100.0, w.population_2018), 4) AS percentage_of_population
FROM covid_cases c
JOIN code_mapping cm ON c.country_code = cm.two_alpha_code
JOIN world_pop w ON cm.three_letter_code = w.three_letter_code
ORDER BY percentage_of_population DESC

WITH daily_new AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    county,
    state_name,
    confirmed_cases,
    confirmed_cases - LAG(confirmed_cases) OVER (PARTITION BY county ORDER BY date) AS new_cases
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_nyt.us_counties`
  WHERE date BETWEEN '2020-03-01' AND '2020-05-31'
    AND state_name = 'Illinois'
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    county,
    new_cases,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY date ORDER BY new_cases DESC) AS rn
  FROM daily_new
  WHERE new_cases IS NOT NULL
),
top5_counties AS (
  SELECT county
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn <= 5
)
SELECT county, COUNT(*) AS appearance_count
FROM top5_counties
GROUP BY county
ORDER BY appearance_count DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH target_point AS (
  SELECT ST_GEOGPOINT(-122.191667, 47.685833) AS pt
),
zip_codes_in_radius AS (
  SELECT z.zip_code, z.zip_code_geom
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes` z, target_point t
  WHERE ST_DISTANCE(z.internal_point_geom, t.pt) < 5 * 1609.344
    AND z.state_name = 'Washington'
),
tracts_with_income AS (
  SELECT 
    t.geo_id,
    t.tract_geom,
    a.total_pop,
    a.income_per_capita,
    a.total_pop * a.income_per_capita AS total_income
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_census_tracts.census_tracts_washington` t
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2017_5yr` a
    ON t.geo_id = a.geo_id
  WHERE a.total_pop IS NOT NULL AND a.total_pop > 0
),
allocations AS (
  SELECT 
    z.zip_code,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(ST_AREA(ST_INTERSECTION(tr.tract_geom, z.zip_code_geom)), ST_AREA(tr.tract_geom)) AS proportion,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(ST_AREA(ST_INTERSECTION(tr.tract_geom, z.zip_code_geom)), ST_AREA(tr.tract_geom)) * tr.total_pop AS allocated_pop,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(ST_AREA(ST_INTERSECTION(tr.tract_geom, z.zip_code_geom)), ST_AREA(tr.tract_geom)) * tr.total_income AS allocated_income
  FROM tracts_with_income tr
  JOIN zip_codes_in_radius z
    ON ST_INTERSECTS(tr.tract_geom, z.zip_code_geom)
)
SELECT 
  zip_code,
  ROUND(SUM(allocated_pop), 1) AS total_population,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(allocated_income), SUM(allocated_pop)), 1) AS average_individual_income
FROM allocations
GROUP BY zip_code
ORDER BY average_individual_income DESC

WITH wage_1998 AS (

        UNION ALL SELECT avg_wkly_wage_10_total_all_industries FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.1998_q3` WHERE geoid = '42003'
        UNION ALL SELECT avg_wkly_wage_10_total_all_industries FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.1998_q4` WHERE geoid = '42003'
    )
),
wage_2017 AS (

    FROM (

  UNNEST(alternate_bases) ab
  WHERE reference_name = 'chr1'
    AND start_position BETWEEN 55039447 AND 55064852

gene_stats AS (

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.gnomAD.v3_genomes__chr1` t,
  UNNEST(alternate_bases) ab,

)
SELECT 
  vs.variant_count,
  ac.total_AC as total_allele_count,
  vs.total_AN as total_number_of_alleles,

FROM variant_stats vs, ac_stats ac, gene_stats gs

         FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` a
         WHERE a.parent_id = q.id

     )
),
question_lengths AS (
  SELECT id, owner_user_id, CHAR_LENGTH(body) as body_length

user_stats AS (

WITH pm10 AS (

pm25_frm AS (

pm25_nonfrm AS (

  WHERE state_name = 'California'

  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH)
),
voc AS (

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.epa_historical_air_quality.voc_daily_summary`
  WHERE state_name = 'California'
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_local) = 2020
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH)
),
so2 AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH) AS month,
    AVG(arithmetic_mean) * 10 AS avg_value
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.epa_historical_air_quality.so2_daily_summary`
  WHERE state_name = 'California'
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_local) = 2020
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH)
),
lead AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH) AS month,
    AVG(arithmetic_mean) * 100 AS avg_value
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.epa_historical_air_quality.lead_daily_summary`
  WHERE state_name = 'California'
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_local) = 2020
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH)
),
all_months AS (
  SELECT month FROM pm10
  UNION ALL
  SELECT month FROM pm25_frm
  UNION ALL
  SELECT month FROM pm25_nonfrm
  UNION ALL
  SELECT month FROM voc
  UNION ALL
  SELECT month FROM so2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT month FROM lead
)
SELECT 
  am.month,
  p10.avg_value AS pm10,
  p25f.avg_value AS pm25_frm,
  p25n.avg_value AS pm25_nonfrm,
  v.avg_value AS volatile_organic_emissions,
  s.avg_value AS so2_scaled,
  l.avg_value AS lead_scaled
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT month FROM all_months) am
LEFT JOIN pm10 p10 ON am.month = p10.month
LEFT JOIN pm25_frm p25f ON am.month = p25f.month
LEFT JOIN pm25_nonfrm p25n ON am.month = p25n.month
LEFT JOIN voc v ON am.month = v.month
LEFT JOIN so2 s ON am.month = s.month
LEFT JOIN lead l ON am.month = l.month
ORDER BY am.month

small_contribs AS (

qualifying_committees AS (

-- Final answer: ZIP code with highest concentration (banks per overlapping block group) - exactly 1 row
WITH co_zip_banks AS (
  SELECT zip_code, COUNT(*) as bank_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fdic_banks.locations`
  WHERE state = 'CO'
  GROUP BY zip_code
),
zip_bg_overlap AS (
  SELECT 
    z.zip_code,
    bg.geo_id,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(ST_Area(ST_Intersection(z.zip_code_geom, bg.blockgroup_geom)), bg.area_land_meters) as overlap_ratio
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes` z
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.geo_census_blockgroups.us_blockgroups_national` bg
    ON ST_Intersects(z.zip_code_geom, bg.blockgroup_geom)
  WHERE z.state_fips_code = '08'
    AND bg.state_fips_code = '08'
    AND ST_Area(ST_Intersection(z.zip_code_geom, bg.blockgroup_geom)) > 0
),
zip_overlap_stats AS (
  SELECT zip_code, 
         COUNT(DISTINCT geo_id) as bg_count
  FROM zip_bg_overlap
  GROUP BY zip_code
)
SELECT 
  z.zip_code,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(b.bank_count, z.bg_count) as concentration
FROM zip_overlap_stats z
JOIN co_zip_banks b ON z.zip_code = b.zip_code
ORDER BY concentration DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_pseudo_id) as distinct_users
FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20210101' AND '20210131'
  AND event_name = 'page_view'
  AND (SELECT value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'page_location') = 'https://shop.googlemerchandisestore.com/'

WITH page_views AS (
  SELECT 
    event_timestamp,
    (SELECT value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'page_location') as page_location,
    (SELECT value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'page_title') as page_title
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_20210128`
  WHERE event_name = 'page_view'
    AND user_pseudo_id = '1362228.4966015575'
),
split_urls AS (
  SELECT 
    event_timestamp,
    page_location,
    page_title,
    SPLIT(page_location, '/') as url_parts
  FROM page_views
),
classified AS (
  SELECT 
    event_timestamp,
    page_title,
    CASE
      WHEN page_location IS NULL THEN page_title
      WHEN ARRAY_LENGTH(url_parts) >= 6 THEN
        CASE
          WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(url_parts[OFFSET(5)], r'\+')
               AND (REGEXP_CONTAINS(url_parts[OFFSET(4)], r'(?i)(Accessories|Apparel|Brands|Campus Collection|Drinkware|Electronics|Google Redesign|Lifestyle|Nest|New 2015 Logo|Notebooks Journals|Office|Shop by Brand|Small Goods|Stationery|Wearables)')
                    OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(url_parts[OFFSET(5)], r'(?i)(Accessories|Apparel|Brands|Campus Collection|Drinkware|Electronics|Google Redesign|Lifestyle|Nest|New 2015 Logo|Notebooks Journals|Office|Shop by Brand|Small Goods|Stationery|Wearables)'))
          THEN 'PDP'
          WHEN NOT REGEXP_CONTAINS(url_parts[OFFSET(4)], r'\+')
               AND NOT REGEXP_CONTAINS(url_parts[OFFSET(5)], r'\+')
               AND (REGEXP_CONTAINS(url_parts[OFFSET(4)], r'(?i)(Accessories|Apparel|Brands|Campus Collection|Drinkware|Electronics|Google Redesign|Lifestyle|Nest|New 2015 Logo|Notebooks Journals|Office|Shop by Brand|Small Goods|Stationery|Wearables)')
                    OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(url_parts[OFFSET(5)], r'(?i)(Accessories|Apparel|Brands|Campus Collection|Drinkware|Electronics|Google Redesign|Lifestyle|Nest|New 2015 Logo|Notebooks Journals|Office|Shop by Brand|Small Goods|Stationery|Wearables)'))
          THEN 'PLP'
          ELSE page_title
        END
      ELSE page_title
    END as display_label
  FROM split_urls
),
with_change_flag AS (
  SELECT 
    event_timestamp,
    display_label,
    CASE WHEN display_label != LAG(display_label) OVER (ORDER BY event_timestamp) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_new_group
  FROM classified
),
with_groups AS (
  SELECT 
    event_timestamp,
    display_label,
    SUM(is_new_group) OVER (ORDER BY event_timestamp) as group_id
  FROM with_change_flag
),
merged AS (
  SELECT 
    MIN(event_timestamp) as first_ts,
    display_label,
    group_id
  FROM with_groups
  GROUP BY display_label, group_id
)
SELECT 
  '1362228.4966015575' as user_pseudo_id,
  STRING_AGG(display_label, '>>' ORDER BY first_ts) as navigation_flow
FROM merged

WITH channel_data AS (
  SELECT 
    CASE
      WHEN traffic_source.source = '(direct)' AND traffic_source.medium IN ('(not set)', '(none)') THEN 'Direct'
      WHEN traffic_source.medium = 'referral' THEN 'Referral'
      WHEN traffic_source.source IN ('baidu', 'bing', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'google', 'yahoo', 'yandex') AND traffic_source.medium IN ('cpc', 'ppc', 'paid') THEN 'Paid Search'
      WHEN traffic_source.source IN ('baidu', 'bing', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'google', 'yahoo', 'yandex') OR traffic_source.medium = 'organic' THEN 'Organic Search'
      WHEN traffic_source.medium IN ('display', 'banner', 'expandable', 'interstitial', 'cpm') THEN 'Display'
      WHEN LOWER(traffic_source.source) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'e mail') OR LOWER(traffic_source.medium) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'e mail') THEN 'Email'
      WHEN traffic_source.medium = 'affiliate' THEN 'Affiliates'
      ELSE 'Unassigned'
    END AS channel,
    COUNT(*) AS sessions
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201201' AND '20201231'
  GROUP BY 1
),
ranked_channels AS (
  SELECT channel, sessions,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY sessions DESC) AS rn
  FROM channel_data
)
SELECT channel, sessions, rn
FROM ranked_channels
ORDER BY rn

-- Final cohort analysis with retention rate as percentage
WITH first_session_per_user AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    MIN(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', event_date)) as first_session_date
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180709' AND '20181002'
    AND event_name = 'session_start'
    AND user_pseudo_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
),
first_touch_per_user AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    user_pseudo_id,
    DATE(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(user_first_touch_timestamp)) as first_touch_date
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180709' AND '20181002'
    AND user_pseudo_id IS NOT NULL
),
new_users AS (
  SELECT 
    fsu.user_pseudo_id,
    fsu.first_session_date
  FROM first_session_per_user fsu
  JOIN first_touch_per_user ftu ON fsu.user_pseudo_id = ftu.user_pseudo_id
  WHERE fsu.first_session_date = ftu.first_touch_date
    AND fsu.first_session_date >= DATE('2018-07-09')
    AND fsu.first_session_date <= DATE('2018-09-17')
),
-- Group users into weekly cohorts (weeks starting Monday)
user_cohorts AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    first_session_date,
    DATE_SUB(first_session_date, INTERVAL (EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM first_session_date) - 2) DAY) as cohort_date
  FROM new_users
),
-- Count users per cohort
cohort_sizes AS (
  SELECT 
    cohort_date,
    COUNT(DISTINCT user_pseudo_id) as cohort_size
  FROM user_cohorts
  GROUP BY cohort_date
),
-- Find users who had a session_start exactly 14 days after their first session
week2_sessions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    uc.user_pseudo_id,
    uc.cohort_date
  FROM user_cohorts uc
  JOIN `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` fs
    ON uc.user_pseudo_id = fs.user_pseudo_id
    AND fs.event_name = 'session_start'
    AND _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180709' AND '20181002'
    AND PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', fs.event_date) = DATE_ADD(uc.first_session_date, INTERVAL 14 DAY)
),
-- Count retained users per cohort
retained_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    cohort_date,
    COUNT(DISTINCT user_pseudo_id) as retained_users
  FROM week2_sessions
  GROUP BY cohort_date
)
SELECT 
  cs.cohort_date,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COALESCE(rc.retained_users, 0), cs.cohort_size) * 100, 2) as week2_retention_rate
FROM cohort_sizes cs
LEFT JOIN retained_counts rc ON cs.cohort_date = rc.cohort_date
ORDER BY cs.cohort_date

-- Final query with clean column names
WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    MIN(event_timestamp) as first_open_ts
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE event_name = 'first_open'
    AND _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180831' AND '20180908'
    AND TIMESTAMP_MICROS(event_timestamp) BETWEEN TIMESTAMP('2018-09-01 00:00:00', 'Asia/Shanghai') 
                                               AND TIMESTAMP('2018-09-08 00:00:00', 'Asia/Shanghai')
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
),
user_days AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    c.user_pseudo_id,
    DATE_DIFF(
      DATE(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(e.event_timestamp), 'Asia/Shanghai'),
      DATE(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(c.first_open_ts), 'Asia/Shanghai'),
      DAY
    ) as day_diff
  FROM cohort c
  LEFT JOIN `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` e
    ON c.user_pseudo_id = e.user_pseudo_id
    AND _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180901' AND '20181015'
    AND TIMESTAMP_MICROS(e.event_timestamp) >= TIMESTAMP_MICROS(c.first_open_ts)
),
user_retention AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN day_diff BETWEEN 1 AND 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as retained_week1,
    MAX(CASE WHEN day_diff BETWEEN 8 AND 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as retained_week2,
    MAX(CASE WHEN day_diff BETWEEN 15 AND 21 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as retained_week3
  FROM user_days
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
)
SELECT 
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(retained_week1), COUNT(*)) as week_1_retention_rate,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(retained_week2), COUNT(*)) as week_2_retention_rate,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(retained_week3), COUNT(*)) as week_3_retention_rate
FROM user_retention
